access.title: What this client may do
access.readWriteHint: Add and edit transactions, categories and spaces.
access.readOnlyHint: Look at your budget without changing anything.

connections.title: Connected applications
connections.subtitle: Every application you have connected, and what each one may do with your budget.
connections.writeHint: This client can add and edit transactions, categories and spaces.
connections.noGrant: Permissions not set. This client can only read.
connections.revokeHint: The refresh token dies at once; an access token already issued keeps working for up to an hour.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.subtitle: Your personal space, and every space you share with someone.

detail.notFound: This space does not exist, or you are no longer a member of it.

invite.label: Add someone
invite.hint: By the exact address of an account that already exists — there are no invitation emails yet.
invite.already: This person is already a member.

leave.title: Leave this space
leave.hint: You lose access to everything in it. Nothing is deleted, and the owner can add you back.
leave.dialogBody: Its transactions and categories disappear from your budget. Nothing is deleted, and the owner can add you back.

remove.title: Delete this space
remove.hint: Everything in it goes too: transactions, their items, categories and the list of members. This cannot be undone.
remove.dialogBody: Transactions, items, categories and members are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
remove.confirmLabel: Type the name of the space to confirm:

errors.notAllowed: Not allowed: only the owner can change a space, and the personal space can never be deleted.
errors.silent: Nothing changed: this space is not yours any more, or it is already gone.
